name: tdcv2
description: TDCv2 for AI agents: a fake and test data generator

plugins.name: tdcv2
plugins.description: Data generator for fake, mock, synthetic and test data: realistic names, emails, addresses, phone numbers, IBANs and more for 95 languages and 198 countries, as CSV, JSON, SQL inserts or any text format. The agent describes the data in a small .tdc config and the TDCv2 engine generates it on your machine — related tables, exact proportions, the same file every time. A Faker alternative for whole datasets: database seeds, test fixtures, demo data.
